Historic Preservation Commission Agenda
  Municipal Services Building – 633 E. Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206

Welcome to the Historic Preservation Commission meeting. The Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast throughout the week. Call (818)
548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office. Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing
anytime at http://www.ci.glendale.ca.us/agenda.aspx?OrganizationID=501. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please
contact the Community Development Department at (818) 548-2115 during regular business hours.

PLEASE TURN OFF ALL ELECTRONIC DEVICES WHILE INSIDE THE HEARING ROOM.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request.
Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign language
translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are
public records, will be available for review in the Community Development Department, 633 E. Broadway, RM 103, Glendale, CA 91206.

  THURSDAY, APRIL 18, 2019, 5:00 P.M.

  1. ROLL CALL – Chris Cragnotti, Nicholas Doom, Mike Morgan, Desiree Shier, Lorna Vartanian

  2. REPORT REGARDING POSTING OF AGENDA
  The agenda for this meeting was posted on or before Monday, April 15, 2019 on the bulletin board
  outside City Hall.

  3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  February 21, 2019

  4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is limited to 5 minutes. The
  Commission may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

  5. COMMENTS FROM COMMISSIONERS

  6. OLD BUSINESS
  a. none

  7. NEW BUSINESS
  a. 1521 N. Columbus (Toll House; GR No. 9): Mills Act Application
  b. 2018: Year in Preservation and Mills Act Fulfillment Overview

  8. PLANNING DIVISION UPDATES and INFORMATIONAL BRIEFINGS
  a. Update on City Council Review of Demolition Deterrence Ordinance
  b. Update on RFP for Proposed South Cumberland Heights and Casa Verdugo Historic Districts

  9. ADJOURNMENT
minutes_text:
City of Glendale
  Historic Preservation Commission
  Municipal Services Building, Room 105
  633 East Broadway, CA 91206

  Action Minutes of Meeting
  Thursday, April 18, 2019

Meeting called to order by Chairperson Vartanian at 5:11 p.m.

1. Roll Call:  Present: Cragnotti, Doom, Shier, Vartanian, Morgan (arrived at 5:27 p.m.)
  Absent: none

2. The Agenda was posted on or before Monday, April 15, 2019.

3. Approval of Minutes: February 21, 2019

  Moved by: Commissioner Cragnotti
  Seconded: Commissioner Doom

  Aye:  Cragnotti, Doom, Shier, Vartanian
  No:  None
  Absent:  Morgan (arrived late)
  Abstain:  None

4. Oral Communications: None

5. Comments from Commissioners:

  •  Commissioner Cragnotti expressed his gratitude for Sean Bersell and his dedicated service
  throughout the years with the Glendale Historical Society.

  •  Chair Vartanian also acknowledged Mr. Bersell for his service.

6. Old Business: None

7. New Business

  a. 1521 N. Columbus (Toll House, GR No. 9): Mills Act Application

  Motion to approve with conditions and the timeline until December 2021 : Pursuant to Section
  15.20.050 of the Glendale Municipal Code , the Historic Preservation Commission recommends to the
  City Council that the property at 1521 North Columbus, known as "The Toll House," be designated as a
  Historic Resource in the Glendale Register of Historic Resources, and that the City Council to authorize
  the City Manager to enter into a Mills Act contract, with a condition to restore the previously cut rafter
  tails, with the property owners for Property tax savings.
 Historic Preservation Commission Minutes  2
April 18, 2019

  Speaker: Richard Cavanati

  Moved by: Commissioner Cragnotti
  Seconded: Commissioner Morgan

  Ayes:  Cragnotti, Doom, Morgan, Shier, Vartanian
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None

  b. 2018: Year in Preservation and Mills Act Fulfillment Overview
  Mr. Platt presented an overview of the various Glendale Register designations, Mills Act contracts,
  and design review cases considered by the Commission during 2018.

  8. Planning Division Updates and Informational Briefings
  a. Update on City Council Review of Demolition Deterrence Ordinance
  The Demolition Deterrence Ordinance will be heard by City Council on May 141h.

  b. Update on RFP for Proposed South Cumberland Heights and Casa Verdugo Historic Districts
  The RFP is under review by the City Attorney's office and the expected date for its release is
  anticipated in the near future.

  Adjournment: 6:55

  Chairperson - Historic Preservation Commission
